{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for the presence of the six QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders found: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if there are any refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check the unique values in the channel and customer_segment columns
print("\nChannel distribution:\n", df['channel'].value_counts())
print("\nCustomer segment distribution:\n", df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of customer_age
print("\nCustomer age distribution (top 10):\n", df['customer_age'].value_counts().head(10))

# Check for any missing or invalid revenue values
print("\nUnique revenue values (first 10):\n", df['revenue'].unique()[:10])"}
